# salesforce_cert (Data Source)

Retrieves information about a Salesforce Certificate.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Retrieve information about a Salesforce certificate
data "salesforce_cert" "integration" {
  developer_name = "IntegrationCertificate"
}

output "certificate_id" {
  description = "The certificate developer name"
  value       = data.salesforce_cert.integration.id
}

output "certificate_expiration" {
  description = "When the certificate expires"
  value       = data.salesforce_cert.integration.expiration_date
}

output "certificate_key_size" {
  description = "The key size in bits"
  value       = data.salesforce_cert.integration.key_size
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `developer_name` (String) The developer name (API name) of the certificate.

### Read-Only

- `certificate` (String) The certificate chain in base64-encoded PEM format.
- `encrypted_with_platform_encryption` (Boolean) Whether this certificate is encrypted with Platform Encryption.
- `expiration_date` (String) The expiration date of the certificate (YYYY-MM-DD format).
- `id` (String) The developer name (API name) of the certificate.
- `is_private_key_exportable` (Boolean) Whether the private key can be exported.
- `key_size` (Number) The key size in bits (e.g., 2048, 4096).
- `master_label` (String) The human-readable label of the certificate.
